sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: I Am Speed - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Admit it, there's nothing better than completely crushing an opponent, right? The easiest way to do it is by taking them out faster than they can even react. From what I've seen, you've learned to act fast, but let's make sure the result sticks."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 25 enemies within one match in CheckPoint, BlastGang, LastHero or TeamFight

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +40,000 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.02
- 99,100 Roubles
- 50 GP coins
- 1× Supply crate (Rare)
